summary: HfO2 and Si nitride thin films were deposited on Ge substrates using atomic layer deposition (ALD) with TDEAH + H2O and SiCl4 + NH3 as precursor combinations. The study aimed to investigate the feasibility of ALD for high-k gate dielectrics on Ge substrates for next-generation MOSFET technology.
evidence: Hafnium oxide (HfO2) thin films were deposited on Ge substrates at 300 /C14C using atomic layer deposition (ALD) with tetrakis(diethylamino)hafnium (termed as TDEAH) as a precursor and water as an oxidant. Si nitride thin films were also deposited on Ge by ALD using SiCl4 as a precursor and NH3 as an oxidant. The study aimed to investigate the feasibility of ALD for high-k gate dielectrics on Ge substrates for next-generation MOSFET technology.
